comment: The vectors pinning Prima.Feed, read by apps/prima/test/prima/feed_test.exs. Every row is plain JSON. Every valid binding reads and writes back as its `json`, its result shape normalized; every invalid binding is refused at `path`, an RFC 6901 pointer into it, for `reason`, one of `reasons`. `inputs` are the component inputs a binding (by index) or its run action (by index) runs with, and `crons` each interval's cron expression. Each binding's `results` pass or are refused at `path` for `reason`. Each envelope is the stream payload for its binding id, binding, revision, time and result: it names the binding and the feed and never the operation, args, reference or interval. A binding's args and a result are bounded by the bytes of their JSON text: `args_max_bytes` and `result_max_bytes`. `bounds` pins the byte bounds on the binding at index `binding`, each row stating `bytes`, the length of its value's Prima.Json text: a result of `result_max_bytes` is accepted and one of a byte more is refused at `path` for `reason`, `size`, even when the value also breaks the shape, whose own refusal `shape_refusal` names; args of `args_max_bytes` are accepted and one byte more is refused `size` at `/args`. `outputs` pins what a feed keeps of a run's output (`Opus.Feeds.accept/5`), read by apps/cyfr/test/opus/feeds_test.exs, which hands each row's `output` to a feed bound to the binding at index `binding`, as its JSON text and, for an object or a list, also as the decoded value. A run's output, a catalyst's or a formula's alike, is an envelope: an object of exactly `status`, an integer, and `data`, or an object holding `error`. The result is the `data` of an envelope whose `status` is 200 to 299, kept as `accepted` once the binding's result shape holds, and data outside that shape is refused at `path`, a pointer into the data, for `reason`. Every other output is refused at the root for `error`, naming the output's `status` when it carries an integer one and nothing else of it.

reasons.type: a value of another JSON type than its position takes
reasons.null: null where the shape is not nullable
reasons.max: a string or list longer than its max
reasons.enum: a value none of the values its position admits
reasons.unknown_field: an object key its fields do not name
reasons.required: a required field or key absent
reasons.unknown_type: a shape whose type is none of the types
reasons.unknown_key: a key its object does not take
reasons.range: a bound or count outside its range
reasons.name: a name outside its grammar
reasons.duplicate: a value repeated where values are distinct
reasons.depth: a shape deeper than its limit
reasons.text: a label outside its code-point range or with a control character
reasons.reference: not a canonically spelt, versionless catalyst or formula reference
reasons.size: JSON text longer than its bound
reasons.json: a value Prima.Json.encode/1 cannot write as JSON text

invalid.why: a binding carries no id: its id is its row's
a name outside the feed-name grammar
a name beginning with a hyphen
a label with a control character
an operation with a control character
args past 4096 bytes of JSON text
an interval of 7 does not divide an hour
an interval is a whole number
a result shape outside the grammar
a run action lacking its operation
a run action lacking its args
a run action's args past 4096 bytes
a refresh action carrying an operation
an action key no action takes
an action's label past 40 code points
an action's name outside the grammar
a result with a key its shape does not name
a result that is not an object
a null where the field is not nullable

envelopes.why: an accepted result, its time given at another offset
a binding with no actions, at revision 0

valid.why: a result of exactly result_max_bytes, 65536 bytes of Prima.Json text

invalid.why: a result of 65537 bytes of Prima.Json text, one past the bound
a result of 65537 bytes that also breaks the shape: the size is refused, not the shape

valid.why: args of exactly args_max_bytes, 4096 bytes of Prima.Json text

invalid.why: args of 4097 bytes of Prima.Json text, one past the bound

rows.why: a 200 envelope: its data is the result
a 299 envelope: every 2xx status is a result
a 2xx envelope whose data is outside its shape, refused at the pointer into the data
an error envelope with a status
an error envelope without a status
an error envelope whose status is 2xx
a 2xx envelope with a key besides status and data
a 2xx envelope that also holds an error
a status that is a string is no envelope
a status that is not an integer is no envelope
the data alone, with no envelope
